texts: On day 21 of Year 1, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
The Council redistributed mire-essence across the lantern-stations.
The Northcove stations contributed mire-essence to the central pool.
The Council issued mire-essence from the central pool to the stations of the Middle Row.
The Council recorded the redistribution in the Watch ledgers.

q1_issues.issue: "the stations of the Middle Row" is encoded as (LocatedIn sk_mr_stations_1 middle_row), asserting a spatial containment the text never states; a genitive of-phrase routes through Possessive / genitive NP (PartOf or Possession), which is exactly what the parallel "Northcove stations" correctly got.

"recorded the redistribution in the Watch ledgers" takes the event's spatial Location, but a document/medium in-phrase is the preposition-named oblique In (the instruction set's "in a statement" case), so this asserts the recording happened at a place that is the ledgers.

review.notes: Across and Possession are used exactly as the open-class oblique and proper-noun-premodifier rules license, and the central_pool fusion with its positional-modifier genus follows the east_wing pattern. (Recipient sk_contribute_1 sk_pool_1) for an inanimate container is defensible under "goal of a transfer" but sits close to the Goal boundary.

issues.reason: "the stations of the Middle Row" is a genitive of-phrase, which *Possessive / genitive NP* routes to PartOf or the opaque Possession, while *Where a THING is* restricts LocatedIn to "in / at / inside / within" — so the atom asserts a spatial containment the text never states.

*Intervals* fixes a medium in-phrase ("in a statement") as the preposition-named oblique In, and the recording event did not take place inside the ledgers — the record did — so (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledgers_1) asserts a place the text does not state.

new_gaps: Episodic bare MASS-noun argument ("redistributed / contributed / issued mire-essence"): witness-minting is specified only for bare PLURAL episodic arguments and the bare kind filler is reserved for non-specific / kind-level ones ("grows wheat"), so a specific mass taking part in a one-off occurrence has no stated routing; the parse put the bare kind symbol mire_essence in Theme slots.

A definite capitalized-common-noun referent used as a nominal premodifier ("the Watch ledgers", where "the Watch" is an already-introduced non-name referent): the proper-noun-premodifier rule keys on proper-noun-hood and *Compound concepts* would fuse watch_ledger and sever the coreference, so neither branch covers a discourse referent in modifier position — a licensed form would have to keep the antecedent symbol and name the link.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0's compliant form is the genitive route the parallel "Northcove stations" NP already took — (Possession sk_mr_stations_1 middle_row), or (PartOf sk_mr_stations_1 middle_row) if the row is read as the whole — in place of LocatedIn; issue 1's compliant form is the preposition-named oblique (In sk_record_1 sk_ledgers_1) in place of (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledgers_1).
adjudication.notes: The Across oblique, the Northcove Possession, the reified "the moon was full" state with its flat dual-emit, and the event-anaphoric (Theme sk_record_1 sk_redistribute_1) are all emitted as licensed. (Recipient sk_contribute_1 sk_pool_1) for an inanimate container stays within "goal of a transfer" and is not a defect.
